text:
CSE_Jordan: Heads-up — AsteriaCloud week0 preflight. They finished VPC peering and want audit logs to Splunk. KMS key is customer-managed, but key policy questions came up. Can SRE/network/security chime in? :wave:
NetworkOps_Maya: Got it. Do we have the exact peering CIDRs and the NAT/Egress IPs? Need to verify firewall ACLs before we open Splunk egress.
Asteria_Tom: Sorry, I can share: VPC CIDR 10.240.0.0/16, peered with our infra VPC 10.10.0.0/16. Egress NAT IPs will be 52.7.120.44/32 and 52.7.120.45/32.
Security_Ravi: Thanks. Two quick KMS checks: 1) Are we allowed to assume IAM role from their account for rotation? 2) Do they want our audit logs encrypted with their key or ours?
CSE_Jordan: They want customer-managed key (CMK) and rotation done by their ops. They asked if Redwood Private agent can write logs encrypted with that CMK.
Security_Ravi: Policy wise that's fine if key policy includes the Redwood service role. Ask them to add: 
```
"Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REPLACEME:role/redwood-private-agent" }
```
and Grant kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt for the log bucket.
Asteria_Tom: OK, I'll send that to our security team. Quick Q — do you support KMS key alias rotation without re-ingesting old logs?
CSE_Jordan: Yes — we can accept aliased CMKs. Recommend keep alias pointing to active key and rotate underlying key. We do not re-ingest logs; indexing continues as long as decrypt perms remain.
DeployBot: preflight-check: vpc_peering: PASS, route_tables: WARN (missing route in 10.10.0.0/16 -> 10.240.0.0/16 on their side), egress_rules: FAIL (splunk:443 blocked). See /ops/preflight/5791234567/report.
NetworkOps_Maya: Jordan, can you confirm if Asteria can add a route on their route-table 'rtb-0a1b2c' to point 10.240.0.0/16 -> pcx-0d9e8f? Also they need outbound to splunk.harvest.example:443.
Asteria_Tom: Will do — I can add the route today. For Splunk egress, our security requires egress via a proxy. We can open outbound to the proxy IP 3.18.200.21:3128 instead. Is that acceptable?
CSE_Jordan: That's fine — we can accept logs via a proxy endpoint. Please confirm proxy TLS passthrough and SNI preserved.
Security_Ravi: Also request their KMS admin to add these two statements: kms:DescribeKey and kms:GetKeyPolicy for our audit tooling. If they prefer, a cross-account IAM role is fine too.
PM_Lena: Note to team — renewal risk flagged: customer noted tight timeline and has procurement milestones in 28 days. If we hit network blockers >72hrs that ups renewal risk. Let's keep the roundtrip low and schedule an enablement call tomorrow 10am PT.
CSE_Jordan: Added — 10am PT invite sent to Asteria_Tom, NetworkOps_Maya, Security_Ravi. Action items: (1) Asteria to add route + proxy details (2) Asteria security to append Redwood service role to CMK policy (3) NetworkOps to validate NAT egress rules after route added (4) We (CSE) to re-run preflight once changes applied.
Asteria_Tom: Will complete (1) and (2) by EOD. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
NetworkOps_Maya: I'll standby to rerun connectivity checks. If route update drops traffic, ping me in #eng-network and I'll trace.
CSE_Jordan: Logging this as account health note — Week0 on track but renewal watch due to procurement. I'll update the CS dashboard after today's meeting.
PM_Lena: Thanks team. If anything slips past EOD, flag for urgent exec sync.
CSE_Jordan: Closing thread for now — follow-up notes will be in the meeting minutes.
